name: Stantek Contract Manufacturing
old_description: Stantek has a long heritage as a leading contract manufacturer located just outside of Lexington, KY. The Company was founded in 2003. However, the current Stantek team has nearly been continuously operating out of the same location for the past 20 years.
about:
Stantek Contract Manufacturing operates from Stanton, Kentucky, just outside Lexington. The company was founded in 2003, though the site had been a Sanmina-SCI contract manufacturing facility until production moved to Mexico that year. In 2017, the Stantek and Monticello teams combined to better support rapid-turnaround replacement parts for major customers' distribution centers. The business was acquired in July 2025 but remains privately held and continues full operations in Kentucky.

Stantek produces wire harnesses, cable assemblies, control cables, electro-mechanical assemblies, and mechanical assemblies. In-house capabilities include high-volume wire processing (cutting, stripping, termination), laser/ink-jet/hot-stamp wire printing, machine braiding, ultrasonic welding (Branson and Techsonic systems), custom Cirris and electrical testing (Fluke instruments), hydraulic press work, machining, tooling and die maintenance, and inventory management. The facility spans 30,000 square feet of manufacturing and warehouse space with 50-plus personnel. The company specializes in low-to-mid-volume, short-run programs and rapid prototyping, with standard wire and connectors stocked for immediate production.

Stantek serves aerospace, military, industrial, robotics, marine, medical, and automotive sectors. Military and aerospace customers include key tier-one government contractors and large commercial aviation OEMs. Industrial clients include major material-handling OEMs and fork-truck OEMs (as referenced in testimonials). Medical equipment manufacturers rely on Stantek for interconnect solutions. The company is ITAR registered (DDTC, Cage Code 14EW7) and manufactures to USML standards.

Stantek emphasizes a 99.9% quality assurance rate under ISO 9001:2015, a 95%+ on-time in-full delivery rate, and over 100 years of combined team experience in harness and assembly manufacturing. The company positions itself on flexible, rapid-turnaround manufacturing without compromising quality, supported by in-house capabilities that enable quick response.

name: Star Plastics, LLC
old_description: Manassas Polymers, founded in 2017, is a high-performance nylon recycler specializing in the reclamation and processing of post-industrial nylon materials. As part of the Star Plastics family since 2021, Manassas expands Star’s capabilities in sustainable, engineered resin solutions with consistent quality and reliable supply
about:
Star Plastics, LLC, headquartered in Millwood, West Virginia, traces its origins to 1988 when parent company SDR Plastics was formed as a post-industrial recycling operation. SDR processed materials destined for landfill, returning them to the polymer market. Ten years later, Star Plastics emerged as a custom compounder, building on that recycling heritage. The company now operates facilities in Ravenswood, West Virginia; Evansville, Indiana; Calhoun, Georgia; and Shandong, China.

The company specializes in custom color compounding, toll compounding, and polymer sourcing for engineering-grade thermoplastics, with a focus on ABS, polycarbonates, polycarbonate alloys, and nylons. Its full-service on-site laboratories develop, test, and formulate custom plastic compounds, offering lot-to-lot consistency and real-time in-process monitoring of physical properties, color, and flame retardancy. Star also provides recycled-content materials up to 100% classification, including pre-consumer, post-consumer, ITE, and ocean-bound grades. The firm emphasizes batches of any size, supported by over 35 years of tolling experience.

Star serves automotive, electronics/electrical, and hybrid vehicle industries, as well as large resin manufacturers. Its materials are UL-recognized and certified for automotive applications. The PolymerVault division sources and supplies resins of any grade or form globally.

Founded on a mission to reclaim plastic waste, Star differentiates itself through a 98.6% material satisfaction rate over three years, weekly continuous-improvement meetings, and a comprehensive analytical lab capable of Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, differential scanning calorimetry, and a suite of mechanical and flammability tests.

name: Steel Craft Technologies
old_description: Steel Craft Technologies, an ISO 9001-2015 certified steel service center located in Grand Rapids, Michigan continues to raise industry standards for quality steel products along with on-time delivery. With our two state of the art facilities totaling 160,000 sq. ft. of manufacturing space, team of qualified staff, and over 25 years of experience in the steel industry, we are here to exceed your company’s expectations.
about:
Steel Craft Technologies was founded in 2001 and operates from two locations in the Grand Rapids, Michigan area: a headquarters in Belmont and a second facility in Grand Rapids. The company began as a steel service center focused on plate processing and has grown to serve the die, mold, and heavy-equipment markets.

Today the company runs two facilities totaling 160,000 square feet of manufacturing space, including an 80,000-square-foot CNC machine shop, and employs approximately 125 people. Its core capabilities cover steel plate processing—oxy-fuel and plasma burning, Blanchard and Mattison grinding, surface milling, and precision CNC machining—as well as fabrication of heavy steel weldments, stress relieving, and media blasting. The shop produces die sets, ejector box assemblies, tooling plates, bolster plates, die parallels, mold rails, and custom weldments such as machine bases and press frames.

Steel Craft serves the die and mold industry, OEM and heavy-equipment manufacturers, and the mining sector. Customers provide CAD files in formats such as DWG, DXF, IGES, STEP, SolidWorks, and Unigraphics, and the company manages projects from material procurement through final machining and coating.

The company emphasizes on-time delivery, ISO 9001:2015 quality management, and ITAR compliance. It also highlights its in-house steel inventory, AWS-certified welders (FCAW 3G per AWS D1.1), and a commitment to recycling 100 percent of mill chips and grinding sludge.

about:
Steel Technologies LLC is headquartered in Louisville, Kentucky. The company was founded in 1971 by Merwin J. Ray, with its first plant in Eminence, Kentucky. After trading on NASDAQ for 22 years, it became a wholly owned subsidiary of Mitsui & Co. (USA), Inc. in 2007. In 2010, Mitsui formed a joint venture with Nucor Corporation, known as NuMit, which now owns 100% of the company. Steel Technologies operates as an independent business under this ownership.

The company processes steel and aluminum across 32 locations in North America, shipping over 3.8 million tons annually to more than 2,500 customer ship-to locations worldwide, with annual sales exceeding $2.5 billion. Its value-added processing includes pre-painted and specialty coated steel up to 0.625 inches thick, high-heat products, and cold metal products. Capabilities extend to supply chain management, logistics, vendor-managed inventory, and technical support, all accessible through a 24/7 customer portal.

Steel Technologies serves the automotive industry, supplying all automotive grades and in exposed blanking for U.S. automakers. Its customer base includes industrial manufacturers across North America, such as Calstrip Industries in Mira Loma, California. The company’s strategically located facilities near railways, waterways, and airports provide cost-saving logistics advantages.

The company emphasizes a customer-driven, growth-oriented culture, citing its dedicated team, extensive capabilities, and broad geographic reach as key differentiators. An unwavering standard of quality and excellence guides its material processing, while its supply chain services aim to deliver cost savings and reliability.

name: Stonewall Cable, Inc.
old_description: Stonewall Cable manufactures cables for the world’s most demanding customers.  From the battlefield to the broadcast booth, laboratory to industrial production floor, our unmatched quality record keeps our customers coming back. Stonewall Cable is committed to being the premier manufacturer of the highest quality communication cables sold to government and industry by:
about:
Stonewall Cable, Inc. was founded in 1985 in Rumney, New Hampshire, as a family business that began assembling cables in the living room of a country home. The company remains family-owned and operates from its facility in Rumney.

The company manufactures a wide range of custom cable assemblies and harnesses, including fiber optic cables (singlemode and multimode OM1–OM4), military-specification circular and fiber connectors, encryption device cables (KIV-7, KG-94, KIV-19, KIV-21, STU-III/STE), network cables (Category 5e, 6, 6a UTP/STP), coaxial assemblies (BNC, 735A, DS0/DS1, T1), RJ21/Telco 50/64-pair cables, and OEM-equivalent cables for vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, and Hewlett Packard. Assemblies are built to custom lengths with jacket options including PVC, plenum, riser, and low-smoke zero-halogen, and the firm supports orders from prototype through production runs.

Stonewall Cable serves defense and government agencies, broadcast and media organizations, industrial manufacturers, telecommunications carriers, and networking and security integrators. Its customer base includes top defense contractors and federal buyers, with products qualified under Federal Supply Class codes and NAICS 334419.

The company emphasizes its commitment to American manufacturing, citing family values, employee trust, continual improvement, and community involvement—including annual Toys for Tots drives and participation in IBM’s World Community Grid—as core differentiators. It maintains ITAR registration, ISO 9001 certification, and TAA/BAA and RoHS/REACH compliance for most products.

about:
Structural Metal Fabricators, Inc. (SMF) was founded in 1979 by Lee A. Held in Palmerton, Pennsylvania. The company began as a service provider for the region's heavy industry and has since expanded to a campus exceeding 61,000 square feet that houses manufacturing, engineering, sales, service, and a parts showroom.

SMF specializes in custom fabrication for work trucks and trailers, offering CNC machining, full hydraulic service, and vehicle and equipment sales, upfit, repair, and maintenance. The operation produces aerial devices, utility equipment, and custom interiors, handling projects ranging from single bespoke units to full fleet builds for commercial clients.

The company serves the energy solutions sector along with individual contractors, specialized trades, and commercial fleets. Customers include utilities and contractors who require purpose-built vehicles such as aerial lifts and service bodies tailored to specific workflows.

SMF emphasizes a truly custom approach rather than modifying off-the-shelf bodies, collaborating with clients to engineer solutions matched to their exact operations. The firm cites its use of high-quality materials, robust fabrication techniques, and an experienced team of engineers and craftsmen as the basis for durable, long-lasting products.

Suntronic is an electronics manufacturing services (EMS) provider headquartered in Richardson, Texas, with production facilities in Houston and Dallas. The company was founded in 1995 and has operated as a privately held business since its inception.

It offers a full range of contract manufacturing services, including quick-turn PCB assembly (with 24-hour prototype capability), box-build integration, cable and wire-harness assembly, electromechanical assembly, conformal coating, and functional testing. Operations run out of more than 100,000 square feet of factory space, supporting volumes from low-volume pilot runs to high-volume production. The company cites state-of-the-art equipment and technical expertise as foundations of its service offering.

The company serves customers in oil and gas, industrial controls, communications, infrastructure, and original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) that require mission-critical electronic assemblies for harsh environments.

Suntronic emphasizes quality built into the process rather than inspected in, maintaining ISO 9001:2015 certification and IPC-A-610-trained personnel. Its stated mission is to develop mutually profitable partnerships and to provide a challenging, rewarding workplace for employees.

about:
TBR Electronics is based in Romeoville, Illinois. The company was founded in November 1990 when Dave Rogala and Ed Pekol established The Board Room, Inc. Rogala brought the conceptual vision while Pekol contributed the technical expertise to turn those ideas into reality.

The firm provides end-to-end electronic product development, spanning firmware and software design, prototype development, and full-scale production. Its manufacturing services include surface-mount technology (SMT) and mixed-technology assembly, low-volume hand assembly and rework, and the integration of complex electromechanical assemblies. TBR also designs and builds custom test fixturing using National Instruments hardware and software, and manages parts procurement for customers. The company has been a Microchip-authorized design partner for nearly three decades.

TBR serves the telecommunications testing and military sectors, among others. Its customer base includes organizations requiring ITAR-compliant manufacturing and specialized encryption development, such as elliptical curve cryptography.

The company positions itself as a single-source solution from concept through assembly, emphasizing its ability to handle both design and production under one roof. Its ITAR registration and long-standing Microchip partnership are cited as key differentiators.

name: TDI Custom Packaging Inc
old_description: “I have ordered large quantities of product from TDI since 2000. I have found TDI to be price competitive, professional and prompt with their delivery. The quality control is excellent and their after-sale record keeping, invoicing, and office contact is timely and accurate.”
about:
TDI Custom Packaging operates from Santa Ana, California, where it has produced custom polyethylene packaging since 1974. The company was founded by Anthony "Tony" Deniger, who began with blown-film extrusion in El Monte before moving to Orange County. It remains a family-owned business, with management directly accessible to customers.

The shop extrudes, converts, and prints a range of high- and low-density polyethylene films, bags, sleeves, tubing, and sheeting. It runs blown-film lines capable of widths from 1 to 42 inches and lengths up to 196 inches, and offers flexographic printing up to four colors on one side or two colors on two sides. Minimum orders start at 100 pounds for narrower widths, and the company emphasizes smaller quantity runs with a current lead time of about four weeks.

TDI serves nurseries with grow bags and plant sleeves, the medical market with gel ice bags, and a broad base of industrial packagers. Long-term customers include a nursery client since 1991 and buyers who have ordered regularly since 1976 and 2000.

The founder's stated philosophy is to supply hard-to-find custom sizes, colors, and formulations that large extruders and importers do not stock. The company highlights its family-owned structure, direct decision-making, FDA-approved resins, and compliance with AQMD and EPA standards as differentiators.

name: TE Wire & Cable
old_description: TE Wire & Cable is the largest manufacturer of thermocouple wire and thermocouple extension cables in the world, providing high-quality, superior accuracy thermocouple solutions for over 70 years. We exceed our customers’ expectations by providing fast quotes and timely service. Our prices are competitive and our product quality standards are second to none. Even if you’re happy with your current supplier,…
about:
TE Wire & Cable LLC operates from Saddle Brook, New Jersey, where it has manufactured thermocouple and specialty wire since 1941. The business originated as the Wire and Cable Division of Thermo Electric Corporation, created to supply high‑quality wire for temperature‑measurement markets spanning cryogenic to 1,300 °C applications. Today it is a subsidiary of Marmon Wire & Cable, a Berkshire Hathaway company.

The company produces a full line of thermocouple wire and extension cable from iron‑ and nickel‑based alloys and copper, with insulation ranging from PVC to CEFIR® ceramic fiber braids. It also provides custom cable assembly, wire assembly, and box‑build services. An in‑house calibration laboratory, directly certified by NIST and accredited to ISO/IEC 17025:2017, calibrates and matches wire from ‑320 °F to 2,400 °F, supporting compliance with AMS2750, ASTM E220, BAC5621 and other aerospace and industrial specifications.

Customers include aerospace composites manufacturers, industrial OEMs, steel and aluminum metallurgy plants, medical device makers, aviation engine test facilities, and power generation operators. The wire serves temperature‑sensing and control circuits in environments from cryogenic furnaces to high‑temperature engine testing.

TE Wire & Cable emphasizes its position as the world’s largest thermocouple wire manufacturer, citing short lead times, competitive pricing, and a calibration program verified against U.S., British, and Dutch national standards as key differentiators.
